sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: After a successful attack, roll the listed weapon, spell, or adversary damage dice and compare the total to thresholds when needed.
When: Use after a hit or when a feature calls for damage.
Not When: Do not roll damage before confirming the attack hit or before checking whether a non-damage outcome ended the danger.
Question: When do I roll damage?
Answer: After the attack succeeds. Roll the listed damage, then compare it to the target's thresholds or stat block instructions.
Example: If a skeleton hits, roll its listed damage; if a PC hits, use the weapon or spell on their sheet.
Aliases: damage die damage dice weapon damage
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
